artifact.self_contained_problem:
Throughout, $\binom{n}{k}$ denotes the usual binomial coefficient, $B_n$ denotes the $n$-th Bernoulli number, $\left(\frac{a}{p}\right)$ is the Legendre symbol, and for an odd prime $p$ the Fermat quotient with base $2$ is $q_p(2)=(2^{p-1}-1)/p$.

Prove or disprove the following three assertions.

(i) (Integrality.) For every integer $n\ge 2$,
$$n(2n+1)\binom{2n}{n}\sum_{k=0}^{n-1}(11k+3)\,\binom{2k}{k}^{2}\binom{3k}{k}\,64^{\,n-1-k}\;\in\;\mathbb{Z}.$$

(ii) (Supercongruence with quadratic-form characterization.) Let $p$ be an odd prime. Then
$$\sum_{k=0}^{p-1}\frac{\binom{2k}{k}^{2}\binom{3k}{k}}{64^{k}}\;\equiv\;\begin{cases} x^{2}-2p \pmod{p^{2}}, & \text{if } \left(\tfrac{p}{11}\right)=1 \text{ and } 4p=x^{2}+11y^{2}\ (x,y\in\mathbb{Z}),\\[2pt] 0\pmod{p^{2}}, & \text{if } \left(\tfrac{p}{11}\right)=-1, \text{ i.e., } p\equiv 2,6,7,8,10\pmod{11}.\end{cases}$$
Moreover, for every positive integer $a$,
$$p^{a}\sum_{k=0}^{p^{a}-1}\frac{11k+3}{64^{k}}\,\binom{2k}{k}^{2}\binom{3k}{k}\;\equiv\;3+\tfrac{7}{2}\,p^{3}B_{p-3}\pmod{p^{4}}.$$

(iii) (Half-range supercongruence.) For every prime $p>3$,
$$p\sum_{k=1}^{(p-1)/2}\frac{(11k-3)\,64^{k}}{k^{3}\binom{2k}{k}^{2}\binom{3k}{k}}\;\equiv\;32\,q_{p}(2)\;-\;\tfrac{64}{3}\,p^{2}B_{p-3}\pmod{p^{3}}.$$

Sun's collection of open conjectures on congruences and reveal subsequent activity on related Apéry-like and Rodriguez-Villegas-type supercongruences (e.g. modular-form and WZ-method approaches), but no source explicitly identified establishes or refutes all three parts of this specific conjecture. Its current status could not be confirmed from the available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Open Conjectures on Congruences (arXiv:0911.5665)
status_evidence.snippet: Collection of open conjectures by Z.-W. Sun, including conjectures of the type involving sums of products of binomial coefficients with coefficients like 11k+3 and supercongruences modulo p^2.
status_evidence.claim: The conjecture appears in a list of open conjectures on congruences.

status_evidence.title: Supercongruences involving products of three binomial coefficients
status_evidence.snippet: Recent paper addressing supercongruences for sums of the form sum (2k choose k)^2 (3k choose k)/c^k modulo p^2.
status_evidence.claim: Closely related supercongruences have been studied recently, but no explicit confirmation of all parts of A4 was found.

status_evidence.title: Superongruences using modular forms (arXiv:2403.03301)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Rodriguez-Villegas-style supercongruences with binomial products that include the family considered here.
status_evidence.claim: Modular-form techniques are being applied to similar supercongruences but the search did not surface a full proof of A4.
